environment: iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.4.1, Home Screen Web App
method: Cross-correlate Safari decodeAudioData Float32 channel samples at 48 kHz against FFmpeg gapless Float32 PCM of the same MP3 at 48 kHz. Search +/-100 ms, then refine to one sample. No playback clock or UI latency is included in this decoder measurement.
interpretation: All four decoded Safari waveforms are shifted +24 ms relative to the gapless reference. Total MP3 duration excess and ffprobe skip_samples alone do not predict this onset offset. No universal browser offset was added based on these four samples.
